discovery.note: Washington's SEPA Register: every SEPA and NEPA record filed with the Department of Ecology since 2000, statewide, published on data.wa.gov (Socrata). Registered because it is the highest coverage-per-hour western source found in the 2026-09-02 scan: one config covers a whole state, where the eastern equivalent is one config per county. The 4x4 resource id is resolved by discover_socrata_dataset.py in CI rather than pinned by hand. The where clause is a guess at the column names until discovery reports the schema; fetch_permits.py logs a socrata error rather than writing a bad candidate file if it is wrong, and the fix is one edit here.
